tools.name: jobs.list
tools.description: List jobs in your journey

tools.name: jobs.get
tools.description: Get details of a specific job

tools.name: jobs.add
tools.description: Add a new job to your journey

tools.name: jobs.update
tools.description: Update a job in your journey

tools.name: jobs.delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a job and its application from the board. Confirm with the user first; it cannot be undone. To hide a job without recording a rejection or closure, use jobs.archive instead.

tools.name: jobs.refresh
tools.description: Queue a job posting to be re-scraped. The returned job may remain pending; use jobs.get later to inspect the refreshed state.

tools.name: jobs.mark_applied
tools.description: Mark a job as applied

tools.name: jobs.archive
tools.description: Hide a job from the active board without recording a rejection or closing the application

tools.name: jobs.unarchive
tools.description: Restore an archived job to the active board

tools.name: jobs.interviews.add
tools.description: Log an interview for a job

tools.name: jobs.interviews.update
tools.description: Update an existing interview

tools.name: jobs.interviews.delete
tools.description: Permanently delete an interview from a job. Confirm with the user first; it cannot be undone.

tools.name: jobs.offer.create
tools.description: Record a job offer with compensation details

tools.name: jobs.offer.update
tools.description: Update the offer recorded for a job

tools.name: jobs.offer.delete
tools.description: Permanently delete the offer recorded for a job (the job stays). Use only to fix a mistake, and confirm with the user first; it cannot be undone.

tools.name: jobs.offer.accept
tools.description: Accept the offer for a job. This is a major state change that closes out the search for this role; confirm with the user before calling. It does not email the employer.

tools.name: jobs.offer.decline
tools.description: Decline the offer for a job, a major state change; confirm with the user first. It does not email the employer.

tools.name: jobs.offer.add_negotiation
tools.description: Log a negotiation event on an offer (counter-offer, update, etc.)

tools.name: jobs.offer.delete_negotiation
tools.description: Remove a negotiation event from an offer

tools.name: signals.list
tools.description: List companies you are tracking

tools.name: signals.track
tools.description: Start tracking a company for new job openings

tools.name: signals.update
tools.description: Update filters on a tracked company

tools.name: signals.untrack
tools.description: Stop tracking a company and delete its signal. Confirm with the user first; they stop getting new openings from it. To stop notifications temporarily instead, use signals.pause.

tools.name: signals.pause
tools.description: Pause tracking for a company

tools.name: signals.resume
tools.description: Resume tracking for a company

tools.name: signals.openings.save
tools.description: Save a matched opening returned by signals.openings.list to your job journey

tools.name: signals.list_applied_jobs
tools.description: List jobs in your journey that came from a tracked company

tools.name: signals.openings.list
tools.description: List signal notifications (new openings at tracked companies)

tools.name: signals.openings.mark_read
tools.description: Mark one opening notification returned by signals.openings.list as read

tools.name: signals.openings.mark_all_read
tools.description: Mark every unread opening notification as read after the user confirms the bulk action

tools.name: inbox.list
tools.description: List email conversations Refine matched to your job search (applications, interviews, recruiter outreach)

tools.name: inbox.get
tools.description: Get one inbox item with its related job and application

tools.name: inbox.get_thread
tools.description: Fetch the full email thread for an inbox item

tools.name: inbox.draft_reply
tools.description: Generate an AI reply draft for an inbox item. Returns HTML for review; it does not send anything.

tools.name: inbox.send_reply
tools.description: Send an email reply through the user's Gmail. This emails a real person from the user's address. Only call after the user has seen the exact message body and explicitly approved sending it.

tools.name: inbox.apply_suggestion
tools.description: Apply an inbox item's suggested action, such as adding an application to the board or recording a rejection. Confirm the specific action with the user first.

tools.name: inbox.undo
tools.description: Undo an auto-applied inbox action. This can delete a board record that the automatic action created, so confirm with the user first.

tools.name: inbox.mark_read
tools.description: Clear an inbox item's unread-reply flag

tools.name: inbox.unsubscribe
tools.description: Unsubscribe the user from this sender's mailing list via one-click list-unsubscribe. This changes the user's real email subscriptions; confirm with them before calling. Use it for unwanted bulk senders, not for a person you can simply decline.

tools.name: inbox.dismiss
tools.description: Dismiss inbox items you are not acting on (also marks the mail read in Gmail)

tools.name: inbox.acknowledge
tools.description: Keep auto-applied inbox items as-is and finalize the automatic action. Confirm the specific items with the user first.

tools.name: inbox.decline
tools.description: Queue decline replies to recruiter outreach. Depending on the user's preference this SENDS email from their address. Only call after the user explicitly approved declining these specific conversations.

tools.name: inbox.refresh
tools.description: Check Gmail for new mail now; returns per-account sync status

tools.name: inbox.sync_status
tools.description: Per-account Gmail synchronization status, including current progress and last sync time

tools.name: persona.get
tools.description: Get the user's persona: inferred job-search preferences and traits with an understanding score. Use it to tailor advice and searches.

tools.name: signals.recommendations.list
tools.description: List companies recommended from one company you track. Get signal_id from signals.list.

tools.name: signals.recommendations.get
tools.description: Get one recommended company with sources and persona fit

tools.name: signals.recommendations.watch
tools.description: Start tracking a recommended company (converts it into a signal)

tools.name: signals.recommendations.dismiss
tools.description: Dismiss a recommended company

tools.name: signals.recommendations.block
tools.description: Dismiss a recommended company and block it from future recommendations

tools.name: signals.recommendations.restore
tools.description: Restore a dismissed or blocked recommendation

tools.name: signals.recommendations.feedback
tools.description: Record why a recommendation was or was not a fit; this sharpens future recommendations and the persona

tools.name: account.agenda
tools.description: Get upcoming interviews and action items

tools.name: integrations.list
tools.description: List connected Google accounts and their grant status. To connect a new account, use integrations.connect_google.

tools.name: integrations.connect_google
tools.description: Get a link for the user to connect Gmail to Refine or approve a missing Gmail permission. Refine selects the permission needed for the connected account. The connection happens in the browser with no Refine sign-in required. Share the link only with the owner of this Refine account.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "jobs.offer.accept" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Accept the offer for a job. This is a major state change that closes out the search for this role; confirm with the user before calling. It does not email the e…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: jobs.offer.accept, signals.openings.list, signals.openings.mark_read, signals.openings.mark_all_read, inbox.list, inbox.get, inbox.get_thread, inbox.mark_read, inbox.unsubscribe, inbox.dismiss, inbox.refresh · Private data: jobs.offer.create, inbox.undo, signals.recommendations.feedback · Public sink: jobs.offer.accept, jobs.offer.decline, inbox.list, inbox.get_thread, inbox.draft_reply, inbox.send_reply, inbox.unsubscribe, inbox.decline, integrations.connect_google · Destructive: jobs.delete, jobs.interviews.delete, jobs.offer.delete, jobs.offer.delete_negotiation, signals.untrack, inbox.undo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: jobs.offer.accept, signals.openings.list, signals.openings.mark_read, signals.openings.mark_all_read, inbox.list, inbox.get, inbox.get_thread, inbox.mark_read, inbox.unsubscribe, inbox.dismiss, inbox.refresh · Private data: jobs.offer.create, inbox.undo, signals.recommendations.feedback · Public sink: jobs.offer.accept, jobs.offer.decline, inbox.list, inbox.get_thread, inbox.draft_reply, inbox.send_reply, inbox.unsubscribe, inbox.decline, integrations.connect_google · Destructive: jobs.delete, jobs.interviews.delete, jobs.offer.delete, jobs.offer.delete_negotiation, signals.untrack, inbox.undo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
